title: Certainty in general — firm assent without doubt or fear
source_text: I. Certitudo in genere est quaedam assensus firmitas qua mens rei propositae citra dubitationem & formidinem assentitur, eique tenaciter & firmiter adhaeret.
pass_a_gloss: Certainty in general is a certain firmness of assent by which the mind assents to a proposed thing without doubt and fear, and adheres to it tenaciously and firmly.
pass_b_english: Mind assents without doubt or fear.
Tenacious, firm adherence to what is proposed.

choices.term: Certitudo in genere est quaedam assensus firmitas
choices.english: Certainty in general is a certain firmness of assent
choices.why: Opens Certitudine tract with genus definition.
rejected: certainty is a weak fluctuating opinion
